summary: Hydro One Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 11, 2026 news release announcing that Hydro One Networks Inc. and Hydro One Sault Ste. Marie LP filed a joint leave-to-construct application with the Ontario Energy Board (the Canadian equivalent of a state utility construction permit) for the North Shore Link, a new 230-kilovolt transmission line linking Mississagi Transformer Station to HOSSM-owned Third Line TS. The C$1.3 billion project, targeted in-service 2029, includes station upgrades and a First Nation equity option for a 50 per cent stake in the line component. No securities transaction or special situation is present.
